subject: general
question: Narendra and Sunil are facing north direction. Narendra rotates 45º clockwise and then again 45º clockwise. How much will Sunil have to rotate so that they both face each other?
solution:
The distance diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f0d9fed4ac67bdb4977a052c658f3b49b972b0e2851c1aec3fd29e505d049ff.png] 

 
• Narendra and Sunil should be facing the opposite direction. Only then will they be facing each other.
 
• Therefore, Sunil has to rotate 90º anticlockwise to face Narendra.
